scope: Three purposively chosen public abstracts. Feasibility demonstration, not a systematic review.
generation: Summaries and structured claim extraction authored by the ChatGPT assistant in this session. Deterministic replay uses the saved records, not fresh LLM calls.
annotation: AI-assisted provisional labels. No independent student annotation or agreement study has occurred. Claims chosen during pilot development, not preregistered.
excluded: No patient data. No adverse-event omission scoring when the abstract does not report adverse events.
